name: adr183-continuation-native-36
result: Retained failure. The continuation completed: capacity initialized, the owner launched (the run-35 owner installation stop did not recur), and the post-launch capacity projection was published with its journal receipt. The hub-worker's capacity workload did not reach ReadyAt within 5 minutes. The hub-worker printed only a generic stop message, so the cause is not visible; the hub-worker now names the stopped child and stage, and the test dumps Pod restarts, logs and capacity_workload phases.
